items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I did the things for Randy Crawford, strings and woodwinds and all that, you know?

ctx.x: That was a -- let me go back awhile, now. Randy Crawford? I did the things for Randy Crawford, strings and woodwinds and all that, you know? Oh, yeah, when Johnny Guitar Watson -- I orchestrated his thing. But the biggest thing was that Cannonball used to come up to my house, right up here on Lookout Mountain, you know? And we had like a spiral staircase, you know, going down the side of the hill. And Cannon was a good actor in reading a script. So he kept coming by, because he wanted me to absorb the script, you…
